description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for GET Api/User/GetTokenHistory. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Returns the authenticated user's token usage history. ownerAgent: account-metrics. Domain: account_tokens. Entity: token_history. Operation: list. Scope: authenticated_user. Use when: Use it when the authenticated user needs to review token charges, credits, awards, paid token entries or AI action usage history. Input: No body. Uses the authenticated user id from Authorization. No Header channel / ChannelOAuthId required. Not admin-only. Output: Returns history items with ReferenceType, Title, TokenAmount, UpdatedOn and ActionTypes. Search terms: user gettokenhistory.
name: hgr_get_user_gettokenhistory
title: Get User Gettokenhistory
